content: D-Ground industrial area mein factory se dhuan nikal raha hai — aankhein jal rahi hain, saans lena mushkil. Kaafi log ghar se bhar gaye hain. Chemical smell bhi aa rahi hai! #FaisalabadChemical
Chemical spill at D-Ground factory confirmed. Workers evacuated. Toxic fumes spreading toward Susan Road residential area. Rescue teams on the way. STAY INDOORS near Sitara Chemical.
Ghar mein bijli nahi 6 ghante se! Clock Tower area. Is garmi mein 45 degree hai aur fan nahi chalta. Koi budhay aur bachay ko kuch ho gaya toh FESCO zimmedar hoga!
3 heatstroke patients brought to DHQ Faisalabad from Clock Tower vicinity. No power = no fans = people collapsing. More cases expected if FESCO doesn't restore by sundown.

Rescue 1122 Faisalabad Unit 5: Confirmed chemical spill at Sitara Chemical Plant, D-Ground. Chlorine gas release — 400m exclusion zone established. 47 workers evacuated, 8 with respiratory symptoms transported to Allied Hospital. Fire Brigade on scene with HazMat team.

FESCO Emergency Ops: 132kV feeder fault at Gulshan Colony substation. Estimated 80,000 consumers without power in Clock Tower, Jinnah Colony, People's Colony. Repair crew dispatched — ETA 4 hours. Heatwave exacerbating health risk.
Susan Road near D-Ground — blocked by emergency vehicles. Speed 0km/h (normal 60km/h). Chemical spill exclusion zone overlaps main arterial road.
PEECA Air Quality Sensor FSD-04 (D-Ground): Chlorine gas reading 18 ppm (threshold: 1 ppm). PM2.5: 412. Sensor buffer full — data upload delayed 8 minutes.
Faisalabad: 45°C, humidity 18%, wind 4km/h. Extreme heat advisory active. Light winds mean chemical plume will not disperse quickly.
